properties.description: Silver layer transformation pipeline for the banking AI log analytics platform. Runs slv_transform_transactions and slv_transform_auth notebooks in parallel, waits for both to complete, executes a COUNT(*) quality check SQL script that fails the pipeline if either silver table has zero rows, then stamps pipeline variables with the validated row counts and final status.

activities.name: nb_transform_transactions
activities.description: Executes slv_transform_transactions notebook. Applies schema enforcement, deduplication, null handling, and PII masking to raw transaction logs, writing the result to the silver/transactions Delta table. Runs in parallel with nb_transform_auth.

activities.name: nb_transform_auth
activities.description: Executes slv_transform_auth notebook in parallel with nb_transform_transactions. Cleanses authentication event logs, enriches with session context, and writes to the silver/auth_events Delta table.

activities.name: scr_validate_silver
activities.description: Runs COUNT(*) quality checks on both silver tables filtered by batch_id and process_date. Raises a hard error via RAISERROR if either table returns 0 rows, causing the pipeline to fail and preventing corrupt/empty data from propagating to gold. Executes only after BOTH notebook activities succeed (fan-in join).

activities.name: set_transactions_row_count
activities.description: Captures the validated transactions row count from the Script output into the transactions_row_count pipeline variable for downstream observability and audit logging.

activities.name: set_auth_row_count
activities.description: Captures the validated authentication events row count from the Script output into the auth_row_count pipeline variable.

activities.name: set_pipeline_status_success
activities.description: Sets pipeline_status to SUCCESS after both row-count variables have been captured, signalling the master orchestrator that the silver layer is valid and gold promotion may proceed.
